turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting clamping unit diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Inspect the clamping arm bodies for cracks or bending deformation. Check each pivot pin boss for looseness by attempting to rock the arm, and inspect the clamping pad faces for wear beyond the minimum thickness.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the clamping arm bodies for cracks or bending deformation. 2. Check each pivot pin boss for looseness by attempting to rock the arm. 3. Inspect the clamping pad faces for wear beyond the minimum thickness.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Visual inspection complete. All clamping arm bodies are intact with no visible cracks or deformation. Pivot bosses are secure and pad faces show normal wear.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the clamping arm bodies for cracks or bending deformation. 2. Check each pivot pin boss for looseness by attempting to rock the arm. 3. Inspect the clamping pad faces for wear beyond the minimum thickness.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are there cracks, deformation or severe wear on the clamping arms?

ground_truth.node_text: Cracks, deformation or severe wear on clamping arms?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No structural issues detected. The arms are in good condition.

ground_truth.node_text: Cracks, deformation or severe wear on clamping arms?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the clamping force within plus or minus 5% of the rated value?

ground_truth.node_text: Clamping force within ±5% of rated value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All stations read within tolerance. The force is right on spec.

ground_truth.node_text: Clamping force within ±5% of rated value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the clamp pad surface condition acceptable?

ground_truth.node_text: Clamp pad surface condition acceptable?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The pad surface looks okay, but I'm noticing the clamp arm itself has some lateral play in the pivot joint that wasn't there before.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The surface roughness is reading high and flatness is out of tolerance at two corners. The pad needs replacement.

ground_truth.node_text: Clamp pad surface condition acceptable?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Replace the clamp pad and apply the correct torque to the retaining screws.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace clamp pad, apply correct torque to retaining screws

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: New pad installed and torqued to specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace clamp pad, apply correct torque to retaining screws

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Command the clamp to fully open and measure the gap with a digital caliper. Then close it fully and probe the sensor actuation gap with a feeler gauge. Compare both measurements against the setup drawing tolerances.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the clamp to the fully open position and measure the gap between the pad face and the reference surface using a digital caliper; compare against the nominal open position dimension. Close the clamp fully and probe the closed position sensor at its trigger point using a feeler gauge to measure the sensor actuation gap. Both values must fall within the tolerance ranges on the clamp setup drawing.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing hydraulic fluid weeping from the piston rod seal—there's a wet ring around the shaft that wasn't there during the last PM cycle.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Open position measured at 48.2 millimeters and closed sensor gap at 0.8 millimeters. Both readings are within the specified ranges.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the clamp to the fully open position and measure the gap between the pad face and the reference surface using a digital caliper; compare against the nominal open position dimension. Close the clamp fully and probe the closed position sensor at its trigger point using a feeler gauge to measure the sensor actuation gap. Both values must fall within the tolerance ranges on the clamp setup drawing.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the open and close sensor positions within plus or minus 0.3 millimeters of nominal?

ground_truth.node_text: Open and close sensor positions within ±0.3 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both positions are well within the 0.3 millimeter tolerance window.

ground_truth.node_text: Open and close sensor positions within ±0.3 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the pivot pin radial clearance within the 0.05 millimeter limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Pivot pin radial clearance within 0.05 mm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The dial indicator shows 0.08 millimeters of lateral play. That exceeds the clearance limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Pivot pin radial clearance within 0.05 mm limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Replace the worn pivot pins and ream the bore to H7 tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace worn pivot pins and ream bore to H7 tolerance

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Pivot pins replaced and bores reamed to specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace worn pivot pins and ream bore to H7 tolerance

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Inspect each grease nipple for proper ball check valve seating. Apply two strokes of grease to each nipple, cycle the clamp three times to distribute it, then wipe excess from the pad face.

ground_truth.node_text: Inspect each grease nipple on the pivot point assemblies for proper seating of the ball check valve by pressing the tip of a grease gun nozzle and confirming the nipple accepts grease. Apply two strokes of the specified grease grade to each nipple. Cycle the clamp arm through three full open and close strokes to distribute the lubricant before wiping excess from the pad face.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All nipples checked and lubricated. Clamp cycled and excess grease removed.

ground_truth.node_text: Inspect each grease nipple on the pivot point assemblies for proper seating of the ball check valve by pressing the tip of a grease gun nozzle and confirming the nipple accepts grease. Apply two strokes of the specified grease grade to each nipple. Cycle the clamp arm through three full open and close strokes to distribute the lubricant before wiping excess from the pad face.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all pivot points correctly lubricated?

ground_truth.node_text: All pivot points correctly lubricated?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Two of the rear pivot nipples weren't accepting grease properly. They need additional attention.

ground_truth.node_text: All pivot points correctly lubricated?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Apply grease to all pivot pin nipples according to the quantity specified.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply grease to all pivot pin nipples, quantity per spec

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All pivot points now properly greased per specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply grease to all pivot pin nipples, quantity per spec

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Set the controller to automatic cycle mode and run 20 consecutive open and close cycles at production speed. Monitor for consistent motion, mechanical shock, and sensor signals. Record the cycle time and compare it against target.

ground_truth.node_text: Set the clamp controller to automatic cycle mode and command 20 consecutive open and close cycles at production speed. Monitor the cycle for consistent motion, absence of mechanical shock at end of stroke, and correct sensor signals at each position. Record the cycle time and compare against the target cycle time; an increase greater than 15% indicates hydraulic or pneumatic system degradation.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Automatic cycling initiated. All 20 cycles monitored and cycle time recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Set the clamp controller to automatic cycle mode and command 20 consecutive open and close cycles at production speed. Monitor the cycle for consistent motion, absence of mechanical shock at end of stroke, and correct sensor signals at each position. Record the cycle time and compare against the target cycle time; an increase greater than 15% indicates hydraulic or pneumatic system degradation.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Did all 20 cycles complete without missed clamp or timeout?

ground_truth.node_text: All 20 cycles completed without missed clamp or timeout?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Cycle 14 timed out on the close stroke. There's an intermittent fault.

ground_truth.node_text: All 20 cycles completed without missed clamp or timeout?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Investigate the cycle fault and check sensor and actuator timing.

ground_truth.node_text: Investigate cycle fault, check sensor and actuator timing

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Found the close sensor was slightly misaligned. Adjusted and verified proper actuation timing.

ground_truth.node_text: Investigate cycle fault, check sensor and actuator timing

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Load the reference part into the fixture and close the clamp to production pressure. Attempt to move the part by applying lateral force by hand, then confirm it doesn't move and record the clamping force reading.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Load the reference part into the fixture and close the clamp to production pressure. 2. Attempt to move the reference part by applying a lateral force by hand. 3. Confirm the part does not move and record the clamping force reading.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Reference part loaded and clamped. Force reading recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Load the reference part into the fixture and close the clamp to production pressure. 2. Attempt to move the reference part by applying a lateral force by hand. 3. Confirm the part does not move and record the clamping force reading.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the reference part held without movement during the simulated cut?

ground_truth.node_text: Reference part held without movement during simulated cut?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The part is completely secure. No movement detected under hand force.

ground_truth.node_text: Reference part held without movement during simulated cut?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the clamp force and cycle data, then update the service record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log clamp force and cycle data, update service record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All data logged and service record updated in the maintenance system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log clamp force and cycle data, update service record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Clamping unit diagnostic procedure complete. The unit has passed all checks and is ready for production.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood. Procedure complete.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
